name: nfip-fl
title: Florida flood insurance claims and policies
summary: Work with FEMA's public flood insurance data for Florida: claims by storm and flood zone, payments, policies in force, repetitive loss, community ratings and the share of homes insured.
description: Each task gives the AI extracts of FEMA's public flood insurance data for Florida, with FEMA's own field dictionary. The question states its facts, such as a county, a year, a date or a definition, and asks for exact figures: counts, totals, shares, medians and the codes behind them. Every question covers a group of at least ten rows, never a single claim or policy. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right.

upstream.name: OpenFEMA, National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) data

families.name: Reading FEMA's codes
families.what: FEMA's codes read with its dictionary: cause of damage, reasons for no payment, deductibles, occupancy and settlement basis.

families.name: Claim counts and payments
families.what: Claim counts, insured units and net payments for a year of loss.

families.name: Claim payments
families.what: Building, contents and compliance payments kept apart and set against damage, value and coverage.

families.name: Claim timing
families.what: The days between the loss and the opening of the claim, and between the loss and the last payment, as medians and shares.

families.name: Named storms
families.what: Claims grouped by FEMA's flood event name and matched to dates, years and event numbers.

families.name: Coastal zones
families.what: Coastal high hazard V zones against A zones, in claims, causes of loss, premiums and repetitive loss.

families.name: Condominiums and occupancy
families.what: Condominium policies counted per insured unit, and rows coded as condominium master policies checked against the dictionary.

families.name: Policies on the books
families.what: Policies in force on a date, cancellations, the parts of the policy cost, building age and occupancy.

families.name: Policy coverage
families.what: Coverage against replacement cost, cost per thousand dollars of coverage by deductible, and premium against full-risk premium.

families.name: Loss ratio
families.what: A loss ratio, defined in the question, from the claims and policies of one county and year.

families.name: County totals combined
families.what: Figures from different FEMA files combined at county level, never row by row.

families.name: Repetitive loss
families.what: How much repeated flood loss there is: categories, total losses, and the shares insured and mitigated.

families.name: Community status
families.what: Community map dates read with their codes, and communities that span more than one county.

families.name: Community rating classes
families.what: How Community Rating System classes and their dates spread, across communities and on policies.

families.name: Share of homes insured
families.what: Residential penetration rates statewide, inside and outside the high-risk flood zone, and by county.

families.name: Checking the rows
families.what: Rows that contradict their own fields or FEMA's definitions, counted. Some checks rightly find none.
